# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Songs

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Song library lookup: search, details, batch retrieval and similarity recommendations.

### `POST /api/songs` — Search songs

Auth: none

Returns a paged list of songs matching the filters, sort order and paging values in the request body. Used by the song grid.

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  search?: string | null
  page?: int
  pageSize?: int
  sortBy?: string | null
  sortDesc?: bool
  genreIds?: string[] | null
  themeIds?: string[] | null
  moodIds?: string[] | null
  artistIds?: string[] | null
  coverArtistIds?: string[] | null
  languageIds?: string[] | null
  energyLevel?: int | null
  tempo?: int | null
  key?: string | null
  karaokeStart?: date-time | null
  karaokeEnd?: date-time | null
}
```

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  items?: {
    id?: string | null
    title?: string | null
    opus?: string | null
    oss?: string | null
    cnPath?: string | null
    absolutePath?: string | null
    playCount?: int | null
    duration?: int | null
    streamDate?: date-time | null
    dateAdded?: date-time | null
    coverArtists?: string[] | null
    originalArtists?: string[] | null
    genres?: string[] | null
    coverArt?: {
      id?: string | null
      fileName?: string | null
      contentType?: string | null
      description?: string | null
      isAnimated?: bool
      credit?: string | null
      cloudflareId?: string | null
      mediaStorageType?: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
      absolutePath?: string | null
      artist?: {
        id?: string | null
        name?: string | null
        socialLink?: string | null
        userId?: string | null
        arts?: object[] | null
      }
      upvotes?: int
      tagString?: string | null
      mediaTag?: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
    }
    thumbnailArt?: { …same as `coverArt` above }
    order?: int
    hasLyrics?: bool
    userUploaded?: bool
    videoId?: string | null
    hls?: string | null
  }[] | null
  totalCount?: int
  page?: int
  pageSize?: int
}
```

### `GET /api/songs/count` — Count songs

Auth: none

Returns the total number of songs in the library.

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
int
```

### `POST /api/songs/{id}/similar` — Get similar songs

Auth: none

Returns songs similar to the given song. The request body is a JSON array of song IDs to exclude (for example, songs already played). Send an empty array for no exclusions. Used for autoplay.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | `string` | yes |  |

### `GET /api/songs/{songId}/lyrics` — Get song lyrics

Auth: none

Returns the timed lyrics for a song as a list of lines, each with `time` and `text`. Returns an empty list when the song has no lyrics.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `songId` | path | `string` | yes |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  time?: date-span
  text?: string | null
}[]
```

### `PUT /api/songs/playcount/{id}` — Record a play

Auth: optional (`Bearer`)

Increments the play count for a song. Pass `playlistId` when the song was played from a playlist. For authenticated users, repeat plays of the same song within the song's duration are not counted.

Authentication is optional. When a bearer token is supplied, the request is associated with that user.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | `string` | yes |  |
| `playlistId` | query | `string` | no |  |

Response `200` OK
